# Project Instructions

- Follow `PROJECT-BRIEF.md` as the confirmed product contract.
- Use the project-local CoTend Skills under `.agents/skills`; do not use or modify global Skill, Plugin, config, auth, or other-project state.
- Governance documents for this owner are written in Chinese. Product code, CLI output, and product errors are English.
- During explicit CoTend Init, create or repair only the minimum governance records, report readiness, and stop. Do not implement product code or create a Git commit in the Init response.
- After the owner resumes the same route, implement only the brief, run proportionate tests, perform formal self-review, and keep AI UAT separate from user acceptance.
- Do not access the network except for the Codex model call. Do not install dependencies, push, publish, deploy, alter Git history, or touch files outside this repository.
